mapper.sql: a.id AS "id", a.beacon_id AS "beaconId", a.device_name AS "deviceName", a.beacon_type AS "beaconType", a.beacon_color AS "beaconColor", a.control_type AS "controlType", a.location AS "location", a.area AS "area", a.map_coord AS "mapCoord", a.pixel_x AS "pixelX", a.pixel_y AS "pixelY", a.real_x AS "realX", a.real_y AS "realY", a.gps_coord AS "gpsCoord", a.gps_longitude AS "gpsLongitude", a.gps_latitude AS "gpsLatitude", a.beacon_status AS "beaconStatus", a.deploy_status AS "deployStatus", a.stream_url AS "streamUrl", a.floor_id AS "floorId", a.building_id AS "buildingId", building_node.map_name AS "building", floor_node.map_name AS "floor", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.status AS "status", a.corp_code AS "corpCode", a.corp_name AS "corpName"
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.beacon_id = #{beaconId} LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.beacon_id IN
#{beaconId}
SELECT * FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%') ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
SELECT * FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.beacon_status = '1' AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
SELECT * FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.area = #{area} AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
SELECT DISTINCT a.area FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.area IS NOT NULL AND a.area != '' AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.area ASC

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(a.area) FROM swm_beacon_station a
a.status = '0'
AND a.corp_code = #{corpCode}
AND a.area IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.area) != ''
ORDER BY TRIM(a.area) ASC

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(a.floor_id) FROM swm_beacon_station a
a.status = '0'
AND a.corp_code = #{corpCode}
AND a.floor_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.floor_id) != ''
ORDER BY TRIM(a.floor_id) ASC
SELECT * FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.pixel_x = #{pixelX} AND a.pixel_y = #{pixelY} AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC

update.foreach:

major = #{item.major},
minor = #{item.minor},
update_date = NOW()
WHERE beacon_id = #{item.beaconId}
